messages.en:
You're always running around like
you've got some urgent business.
Why don't you just sit
a spell and relax?

Siempre vas corriendo a todos sitios.
Debes tomarte la vida con más calma.
messages.pt:
You're always running around like
you've got some urgent business.
Why don't you just sit
a spell and relax?

messages.en:
You're getting pretty tough,
aren't you, kid?
Bet you're still no match
for me, though...

Jovencito, estás haciéndote un gran
hombre, pero aún te queda mucho
para igualarte a mí.
messages.pt:
You're getting pretty tough,
aren't you, kid?

Did I scare ya?

¡Buuu!

Sigh. I guess my heart's just not in it.
Maybe I'm not cut out for this...

Haven't you ever wondered why I'm
always hanging out around here?
Well, you see...

I've been waiting to EAT you!

Just kidding.

¿Has pensado alguna vez por qué
estoy siempre aquí?

¡Es para comerte a ti!

The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}is gonna be SO mad at me.

I just can't find that {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}...

I don't know... The {Color:Green}king{Color:White}'s mood
just keeps getting worse and worse.

This stall is such a mess! Does that
mean Beedle's not going to show up?

Qué sucio está...
No creo que se siente nadie...

This stall is such a mess! Does that

Don't they have anything other than
fruits and vegetables here?

Don't they have anything other than
fruits and vegetables here?

messages.en:
Hey, hey!
Lookie, lookie!
messages.es_ref:
¡Tengo las mejores ofertas!
¡Fruta fresca! ¡Fruta fresca!
messages.pt:
Hey, hey!
Lookie, lookie!

messages.en:
Hurry up and buy something,
or I smack you!
messages.es_ref:
¡Vamos, que la fruta se pasa!
¡A comprar, a comprar!
messages.pt:
Hurry up and buy something,
or I smack you!

messages.en:
Hey, hey! Cabbage and leeks, carrots
and eggplant! Get 'em all right here!

¡Col, coliflor, zanahorias!
¡Bueno, bonito y barato!
messages.pt:

messages.en:
Wha--? It's so small you can't
understand? Hey hey!

¿Cómo? ¿Son tan pequeños
que no los ves bien?

understand? Hey hey!

What's going on with the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}lately?
He seems like...he's not himself...

¿Qué le pasará al {Color:Green}rey{Color:White}?
Parece otra persona...
messages.pt:
What's going on with the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}lately?

messages.en:
That river sure is fishy!
I mean suspicious...
But I can't quite figure out why...
messages.es_ref:
Este río es sospechoso.
Aunque no sabría explicar
por qué me da tan mala
espina...
messages.pt:
That river sure is fishy!
I mean suspicious...
But I can't quite figure out why...

messages.en:
Hey, kid! Did you stay at the inn?
Well? And did you get your gift?
messages.es_ref:
¿Vas a pasar por la posada, joven?
Creo que te regalarán algo...
messages.pt:
Hey, kid! Did you stay at the inn?
Well? And did you get your gift?

messages.en:
The {Color:Green}king {Color:White}hasn't made any public
appearances lately.
And with so many guards surrounding
the castle over the past few days...
nobody in town has a clue what's
going on in there!

del castillo. ¿Qué habrá ocurrido?

right now, and I simply can't let you in!

Estamos dando clase.
No se puede pasar.

We're studying math right now, but once
we're done, that's it for the day!

Es la última clase del día.

I'm starting to think I won't find any
{Color:Red}light force {Color:White}near the castle.

¿Cómo vamos a encontrar la {Color:Red}fuerza{Color:White}

I'm starting to think I won't find any

There's an old legend that something

Dicen que si se toca esta campana,
ocurrirá algo en Hyrule...

I'm too scared to ring it myself, so I'm
hoping someone else will come along...

atrevo a tocarla. Que la toque otro...

Aww, gee. It looks like they're having

¡Qué guay! ¡Parece muy divertido!
¡Yo también quiero!...
messages.pt:
Aww, gee. It looks like they're having

It looks like the simulation arcade is
open for business. Simon's here now.

Parece que ya han abierto.
Vesga está en el mostrador.

It looks like the simulation arcade is
open for business. Simon's here now.

messages.en:
Nobody ever returns the books they
check out from the library.
messages.es_ref:
Hay mucha gente que no devuelve
los libros a la biblioteca...
messages.pt:
Nobody ever returns the books they
check out from the library.

messages.en:
Don't they realize that other people
might want to read these books, too?
messages.es_ref:
¡Y hay que devolverlos pronto para
que los pueda leer más gente!
messages.pt:
Don't they realize that other people
might want to read these books, too?

messages.en:
I would love to have a figurine,
too, but they're too big for me...

Yo también quiero una figurita, pero
son demasiado grandes para nosotros.

I would love to have a figurine,

But I'm not such a good swimmer.

Si me tiro a la fuente, seguro
que me ahogo...
messages.pt:
I want to dive into the fountain!
But I'm not such a good swimmer.

Ghosts are scary.
He seems like a funny ghost,
but ghosts are still scary.
Aren't they scary?

Me dan miedo los fantasmas.
Parece un fantasma pacífico...
pero me sigue dando mucho miedo.
messages.pt:

but ghosts are still scary.

Oooofff...
Ahh, it's no good.
I just can't get anywhere.
Man oh man oh man...

Aggg... Agggrr...
Imposible, no puedo seguir...

Ahh, it's no good.

!!!!?

You made it?!
No way!!

(!)
(?)
¿Has ido y vuelto?
¡Qué bárbaro!

!!!!?

You made it?!
No way!!

messages.en:
Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.

Me alegro de que hayas venido.
No suele venir nadie por aquí.
Toma, es para ti.

The view from here is nice.

And Swiftblade's screams during

Good job getting up here.
Really. That's impressive.

messages.en:
Lately, Mutoh's been grumbling about
how there's no work with any punch.
I wish I could do something about that,
but I don't even know what he means!

Últimamente, {Color:Green}Muto, el maestro
carpintero{Color:White}, se queja de que no
hay trabajo digno para él.
Me gustaría animarlo.

messages.en:
I'm so glad the boss is back to his
usual self.
It just makes you grateful
for the good times, you know?

Me alegro de que el jefe
se encuentre mejor.
Me gusta verlo así.

I can hear those schoolkids laughing

Desde aquí se oyen las risas
de los niños que están en el colegio.

messages.en:
You know, even this headband can be
used as a weapon.
A real man has to be able to do battle
with whatever is at his disposal.
messages.es_ref:
Para trabajar, lo mejor es atarse
un pañuelo en la cabeza para secar

puede resultar útil para defenderse.

A casa, me voy a casa.

Hey, hey! It's a closeout sale!

Clearance prices, people! What are
you waiting for!? Hey, hey!

Compren, ¡que se acaba!
messages.pt:
Clearance prices, people! What are
you waiting for!? Hey, hey!

Hey, hey! My mom'll be mad if I take all
this stuff home, so shop up!

¡Vamos que nos vamos!
Mi mujer se va a enfadar mucho
si me ve aparecer con toda esta
mercancía sin vender.
messages.pt:
Hey, hey! My mom'll be mad if I take all
this stuff home, so shop up!

messages.en:
Anyone want to trade for fruit!?
Anybody? Hello? Hey, hey!
messages.es_ref:
Igual podría cambiar algo de mercancía
por fruta fresca...
messages.pt:
Anyone want to trade for fruit!?
Anybody? Hello? Hey, hey!

messages.en:
I can't believe this. {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}
has been overrun with monsters...

¿Estará a salvo el rey? ¿Qué ocurrirá
con la gente que estaba dentro?
messages.pt:
I can't believe this. {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}
has been overrun with monsters...

messages.en:
The monsters will be coming for us
next! We'd better stay inside!
messages.es_ref:
¿Y si vinieran los monstruos también
a la ciudadela?
Más vale que todo el mundo se vaya
a su casa.
messages.pt:
The monsters will be coming for us
next! We'd better stay inside!

messages.en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has become nothing more
than a giant nest for monsters!
Those of us who are left must protect
the town from those beasts!
messages.es_ref:
¡El {Color:Green}castillo de Hyrule{Color:White} se encuentra
bajo el poder de las tinieblas!
¡Debemos proteger la ciudadela!
messages.pt:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has become nothing more
than a giant nest for monsters!
Those of us who are left must protect
the town from those beasts!

messages.en:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.
messages.es_ref:
Dicen que si se toca esta campana,
ocurrirá algo en Hyrule...
messages.pt:
There's an old legend that something
big will happen when Hyrule's bell rings.

messages.en:
I think the time has come. The time
spoken of in legends.
I'm...moved beyond words...
messages.es_ref:
¡Por fin, por fin ha llegado el momento
del que tanto hablaban las leyendas!
messages.pt:
I think the time has come. The time
spoken of in legends.
I'm...moved beyond words...

messages.en:
Tighten the defenses around the town!
Don't let them in, no matter what!
messages.es_ref:
¡Hay que defender la ciudadela!
¡Que no entren en la ciudadela!
messages.pt:
Tighten the defenses around the town!
Don't let them in, no matter what!

messages.es_ref: Grrr... ¡Guau, guau!
messages.pt: Rrrrr...ARF ARF!

messages.pt: Arf arf!

messages.en: Awooooo!!!
messages.es_ref: ¡Guauuu!
messages.pt: Awooooo!!!

messages.en:
That kid over there in the glasses
is such a weirdo...
You could probably tell by looking at
him. He's all right, really.
I mean, it's just hard to hate
a guy like that! Hehehe...
messages.es_ref:
Ese chico de las gafas de ahí, es más
raro que un perro verde...
Pero es bastante buena gente.
messages.pt:

My {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}! They're alive!
They're moving!
Hehehehe...
That's SO cool!!

¡Las {Color:Green}figuritas{Color:White} del Club Minitendo se
mueven! ¡Están vivas! ¡Están vivas!
¡Sí! ¡Hurra! ¡Hurra! ¡Hurra!
messages.pt:
My {Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}! They're alive!
They're moving!
Hehehehe...
That's SO cool!!

messages.en:
This is definitely not the time to be
looking for that dumb {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}.
messages.es_ref:
Creo que no es momento
de buscar la {Color:Red}fuerza{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
This is definitely not the time to be
looking for that dumb {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}.

It's so lonely here now... I wonder
if the monsters really are coming.

Empiezo a tener miedo... ¿De verdad
que nos van a atacar monstruos?
messages.pt:
It's so lonely here now... I wonder
if the monsters really are coming.

messages.en:
I'm a rich guy, see?
And I'm a collector to boot.

Yo soy bastante pudiente y una de
mis mayores aficiones es comprar
colecciones de figuritas moldeadas
a mano. ¿A que son lo más?

I'm a rich guy, see?
And I'm a collector to boot.

messages.en:
If you ever find a complete set of
{Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}, you should tell me.
You...do know what I'm talking about,
don't you? Well? Get to it!

Si alguna vez consigues toda la
{Color:Blue}colección{Color:White} de {Color:Green}figuritas{Color:White} del Club
Minitendo, tráela por aquí y te
recompensaré. ¿Guay?

If you ever find a complete set of
{Color:Red}figurines{Color:White}, you should tell me.
You...do know what I'm talking about,
don't you? Well? Get to it!

messages.en:
!?

Whooooooooooooaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!

You did it! I can't believe you did it!
This is...a totally complete set!
How incredibly awesome! And you even
got the legendary Carlov Medal!!! 
It shines with a beautiful light...
It's every collector's dream!
What you've shown me here... It's
just... It's just amazing.
Here, feel free to go in my house and
take whatever you want in thanks...
'Cuz, you know, I'm rich! Hahaha!
messages.es_ref:
(!) (?)

¡Hiper-mega-guay!

¡Las has conseguido!
¡La colección completa!
No hay nada más emocionante
para un coleccionista como yo.
Gracias. A cambio, dejaré que
entres en mi casa y te lleves
lo que quieras. ¡Qué generoso soy!

!?

What an awesome day...

¡Eres un gran coleccionista!
¡Qué día tan maravilloso!

Way to go, man.
What an awesome day...

Evacuation?! What a pain...

But I don't want to cause any trouble,
so I guess I'll just have to cooperate.

¿Hay que esconderse? Qué rollo...
Bueno, lo haré, pero sólo porque
no quiero molestar a los demás.
messages.pt:
Evacuation?! What a pain...

But I don't want to cause any trouble,

Everyone's getting out of here.
Will there even be a Hyrule Town soon?

algo en la ciudadela de Hyrule?

Everyone's getting out of here.
Will there even be a Hyrule Town soon?

Maybe I should go hide in the cucco

It might be dangerous, though. It
seems like there's danger everywhere.

Si no estuviese ese fantasma,
me escondería en la casa de la dueña
de los cucos. No sé qué prefiero...
¿Un fantasma o los monstruos?

lady's house...
It might be dangerous, though. It

messages.en:
Hey, you came back?

Not a lot of people are coming
by anymore... Not these days.
I guess that means you really
like me, huh?

¿Otra vez aquí? No hay mucha gente
que venga por aquí hoy en día.
¿Tanto te gusto?

We're under martial law!?
Which Minish house should I go to?
If I end up somewhere alone,
they'll forget all about me!
Oh goodness, oh goodness!

No sé en qué casa minish meterme.
Si elijo mal, estoy perdido...
Qué indecisión...

Thanks for coming.

Hardly anyone ever visits, and it gets
lonely here. Please take this.

Me alegro de que hayas venido.
No suele venir nadie por aquí.
Toma, es para ti.

Lately, {Color:Green}Mutoh{Color:White}'s been grumbling about
how there's no work with any punch.

but I don't even know what he means!

Últimamente, {Color:Green}Muto, el maestro
carpintero{Color:White}, se queja de que no

a ghost? Or maybe...a monster?
I'm not afraid! I'm going to defend
Hyrule, no matter what!

messages.en:
Ho ho! Well certainly!
Now how shall I put this...
"We offer you the chance to be
the hero you dream of becoming!"
We allow you to fight grand monsters
without any danger!
This is our unique service!
Now...
I can't say this too loudly, but...

If you dispatch a monster skillfully
enough, you might get {Color:Blue}something nice{Color:White}.
Now, even though this is only a
simulation...
It is still not for the faint of heart!

If you should die in this simulation,
why then... Well, I don't know!
It's never happened!!

{07:3D:03}

vientos, pero si demuestras ser
un gran guerrero, te llevarás un
{Color:Blue}regalo{Color:White}.
Quizá lo hayas visto alguna vez...

Eso sí, no te confíes porque sea
un juego, ya que puedes hacerte
mucho daño. Si te quedas sin vida
en el juego, te ocurrirá lo mismo
en este mundo...
¡No sé lo que puede ocurrir allí!
{07:3D:03}

messages.en:
You found and returned the book for
me, did you? I'm very grateful.
Here, let me tell you something
interesting as thanks.
You see, the Minish did not always live
in our world.
No, they came through a secret portal
many ages ago from their world to ours!
But don't tell anyone! It's a valuable
bit of knowledge that only I know!
And I gleaned it only after hours of
study from an incredibly old book.
messages.es_ref:

nos son originarios de este mundo.

pasaron a nuestro mundo a través
de una puerta que nos conecta.
Lo descubrí en un libro, pero es mi
gran secreto, no se lo digas a nadie.

So you've come to hear more about the
Minish, have you?
Well, I can part with one more tidbit,
I suppose... It could be useful.
The portal linking us to the Minish
world opens only once every 100 years.
That means the Minish here now are
descendants of those who came before.
That's right! Those Minish came here
100 years ago, or even longer ago!
Now that the portal is open this year,
perhaps new Minish will come through...

te contaré una cosa más. La puerta
secreta que une el mundo de los
hombres y el de los minish se abre
cada cien años. Este año la puerta
está abierta. Así que igual hay
minish visitando nuestro mundo.

That's my idea of a good cafe.

Mi cafetería ideal sería el lugar donde
pudiera esperar a la llegada del fin
de siglo...
messages.pt:

messages.en:
Hey there!
Doin' well?
messages.es_ref: Hola, ¿qué tal estás?
messages.pt:
Hey there!
Doin' well?

messages.en:
We're counting on you, young man!
Heehee!
messages.es_ref:
Espero mucho de ti, joven.
Je, je...
messages.pt:
We're counting on you, young man!
Heehee!

messages.en:
Everything with a beginning
also has an end.
To put it another way, all things move
toward their end...
Even from the moment they begin.
messages.es_ref:
Todo tiene un principio y un final.

Mientras te digo esto, seguro que
ha empezado algo para llegar a su fin.
messages.pt:

also has an end.
To put it another way, all things move
toward their end...
Even from the moment they begin.

messages.en:
The end is near.
For me, as well as for you.
messages.es_ref:
El final está cerca,
para todo el mundo.
messages.pt:
The end is near.
For me, as well as for you.

messages.en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} is covered in darkness.
This is the end.
messages.es_ref:
El {Color:Green}castillo de Hyrule{Color:White} ha sido tomado
por las tinieblas... ¡Es el fin!
messages.pt:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} is covered in darkness.
This is the end.

messages.en:
I never imagined something like this
would happen in my lifetime.
I wonder if the {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}will show up
and help us once again...
messages.es_ref:
Nunca pensé que llegaría a ver algo
parecido. Espero que los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} nos
salven de nuevo...
messages.pt:

messages.en:
Cheers! Yaay! Cheers!
Raise your milk for a toast!
I never knew that failing to make
dinner would have such consequences!
messages.es_ref:
¡Salud! ¡Salud!
¡Brindemos con leche!
¡Nunca pensé que ocurriría
algo tan horrible sólo por no
hacer la cena un día!

messages.en:
Just try fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} with
lots of people.
There are a lot of people out there
looking for someone to fuse with.
messages.es_ref:
Debes intentar {Color:Blue}probar suerte{Color:White} con quien
puedas. Hay mucha gente que querrá
ver si sus piedras de la suerte
encajan con las tuyas.
messages.pt:
Just try fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} with
lots of people.
There are a lot of people out there
looking for someone to fuse with.

messages.en:
You'd be surprised to find who--and
what--you can {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones {Color:White}with!
Yeah, you've got a lot of fusing in
your future, pal...
messages.es_ref:
Los hombres no son los únicos que
prueban suerte con las piedras...
Quizá quiera probar suerte {Color:Blue}quien menos
te lo esperas{Color:White}...
messages.pt:

messages.en:
I recommend visiting {Color:Blue}places you've
already been{Color:White}.
You may then be able to fuse Kinstone
pieces in those places, you know?
messages.es_ref:
Te recomiendo que te pases por {Color:Blue}lugares
en los que hayas estado ya{Color:White}.
Igual puedes probar suerte con alguien
nuevo.
messages.pt:

messages.en:
You can get special items by fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}!
Don't miss out on the opportunity!
messages.es_ref:
No pierdas nunca la oportunidad
de adquirir nuevos objetos {Color:Blue}probando
suerte{Color:White} con tus piedras de la suerte.
messages.pt:
You can get special items by fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}!
Don't miss out on the opportunity!

messages.en:
There's a {Color:Green}group of lovely young ladies
{Color:White}visiting Hyrule...
Maybe I'll get a chance to talk to them
if I offer to fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}. Heh.
messages.es_ref:
Parece que han venido a la ciudadela
{Color:Green}muchachas realmente hermosas{Color:White}.
No sé si hablar con ellas con la
excusa de {Color:Blue}probar suerte{Color:White} juntos...
messages.pt:
There's a {Color:Green}group of lovely young ladies
{Color:White}visiting Hyrule...
Maybe I'll get a chance to talk to them
if I offer to fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}. Heh.

messages.en:
I hear there's a wall in {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}
with a spot for a {Color:Blue}Kinstone piece{Color:White}.
I'm sure you can find other places
where you can place Kinstone pieces.
messages.es_ref:
Cuentan que en el {Color:Green}bosque minish{Color:White}
hay un muro capaz de {Color:Blue}probar suerte{Color:White}.
También dicen que hay otro muro igual
al otro lado de un agujero.
messages.pt:

with a spot for a {Color:Blue}Kinstone piece{Color:White}.
I'm sure you can find other places
where you can place Kinstone pieces.

messages.en:
Do you know of the {Color:Green}Goron Cave{Color:White}? It's a
tunnel that the {Color:Green}Gorons {Color:White}are digging.
And if you can get all the way to the
cave's end and place a {Color:Blue}Kinstone{Color:White}...
Well, why don't I just let you try it
for yourself!
messages.es_ref:
¿Conoces la {Color:Green}cueva de los goron{Color:White}?
Es una cueva que los {Color:Green}goron{Color:White} cavan con
esfuerzo. Si llegas al final, {Color:Blue}prueba
suerte{Color:White} con tus piedras...
Deberás seguir investigando tú solo.
messages.pt:

messages.en:
I hear you can fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}
with the {Color:Green}ghost {Color:White}in the {Color:Green}Royal Crypt{Color:White}.
Or at least so I hear. I'm too scared
to find out for sure.
messages.es_ref:
Dicen que los fantasmas que moran el
{Color:Green}mausoleo real{Color:White} {Color:Blue}prueban suerte{Color:White}
con sus piedras. Como a mí me da
miedo ir, no sé si es verdad o no.
messages.pt:
I hear you can fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}
with the {Color:Green}ghost {Color:White}in the {Color:Green}Royal Crypt{Color:White}.

to find out for sure.

messages.en:
You can't always just charge straight
ahead to new places in life, you know.
You need to go back to places you've
already been and reflect on things.
Who knows? That quiet reflection may
give you a chance to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
messages.es_ref:
En esta vida no todo es avanzar{Symbol:16}
hay que volver a andar los caminos.
Poner a prueba tu suerte puede
ser realmente útil...
messages.pt:
You can't always just charge straight
ahead to new places in life, you know.
You need to go back to places you've
already been and reflect on things.
Who knows? That quiet reflection may
give you a chance to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!

messages.en:
You know, fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} can
get you more than mere {Color:Red}Rupees{Color:White}...
It can call new people to a place or
even change the way the town looks.
And all those things can lead
to happiness as well, right?
messages.es_ref:
Si {Color:Blue}pruebas suerte{Color:White}, no sólo
conseguirás {Color:Red}rupias{Color:White}, también
verás otra cara de la gente y de los
lugares donde estés.
Quizá así encuentres la felicidad.
messages.pt:

And all those things can lead
to happiness as well, right?

messages.en:
Are you enjoying fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White}?
Fusing can bring happiness to you and
your fusing buddy! That's what I say!
messages.es_ref:
¿Te gusta {Color:Blue}probar suerte{Color:White}?

Lo mejor es que los dos participantes
pueden recibir muy buena suerte.
messages.pt:
Are you enjoying fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White}?
Fusing can bring happiness to you and

messages.en:
I wonder what happens if you fuse all
of the Kinstones a person is holding...
messages.es_ref:
Quizá cuando consigas unir las
mitades de las piedras de alguien,
le ocurra algo maravilloso.
messages.pt:
I wonder what happens if you fuse all
of the Kinstones a person is holding...

messages.en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has fallen to the
darkness...
I suppose this is no time to be fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}, is it?
messages.es_ref:
El {Color:Green}castillo de Hyrule{Color:White} ha sido tomado
por las sombras...
Quizá ya no sea momento
de {Color:Blue}probar suerte{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has fallen to the
darkness...
I suppose this is no time to be fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}, is it?

messages.en:
Nonsense! Maybe we need it now more
than ever before!
Fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} can bring
people happiness!
This is the true motive for fusing, my
friend! Not Rupees, but happiness!
messages.es_ref:
¡Pensándolo bien! Es justo ahora
cuando la gente necesita más {Color:Blue}buena
fortuna{Color:White}. Sí, ahora hace más falta que
nunca... ¡Yo quiero probar suerte por
la suerte, no por las rupias!
